name: Narimasu
tagline: Shinjuku in 33 minutes and Shibuya in 37 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Itabashi City, where Tobu and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 42 minutes to Otemachi, 33 minutes to Shinjuku, 37 minutes to Shibuya and 59 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 32.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 18.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 32.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 16.6 m to 34.9 m, a difference of 18.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 国立病院機構埼玉病院, about 20 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 国立病院機構 埼玉病院, about 20 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. Tobu Tojo Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (Tobu runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺, which this station is not on. Tobu Tojo Line runs at 131%. Its busiest stretch is 北池袋→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line runs at 117%. Its busiest stretch is 要町→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 2LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. What pushes the figure up: 3 lines and a wide choice of connections and a small projected flood depth. For 1LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Chikatetsu-Akatsuka is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Narimasu is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Narimasu in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Narimasu. To Shinjuku, for instance, Chikatetsu-Akatsuka is 4 minutes quicker. On quiet, Narimasu comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Hikarigaoka is ahead on quiet, but Narimasu is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: About 2 km from Narimasu in a straight line. Hikarigaoka has only the Toei Oedo Line, so Narimasu is the better connected. To Roppongi, for instance, Hikarigaoka is 10 minutes quicker. A one-room flat also costs about ¥9,000 more at Hikarigaoka. On what it offers families, though, Hikarigaoka comes out ahead.
